audit_question: Does each bounded reference implementation enforce the defining invariant stated by its company innovation mechanism, rather than merely execute successfully?

classification.ALIGNED_REFERENCE: The bounded implementation enforces the mechanism's defining invariant closely enough for reference-build status.
classification.PARTIAL_REFERENCE: A useful kernel exists, but at least one material invariant named by the mechanism is absent.
classification.REPAIR_REQUIRED: A core semantic or proof defect allows a misleading pass or omits the mechanism's central behavior.

items.implemented: required paths, forbidden surfaces, and expected-test presence
items.missing_invariant: architectural constraints and out-of-scope changed surfaces are not modeled, so intent drift outside an explicit forbid set can pass
items.repair: add allowed-surface and architecture-constraint comparison to alignment

items.implemented: normalizes required workcell interface fields
items.missing_invariant: field presence is treated as compatibility; no canonical interface standard or cross-cell mismatch detection exists
items.repair: compare normalized cells against a reusable canonical contract and fail incompatible fixtures/safety/task interfaces

items.implemented: weighted latency/energy/memory/privacy target scoring
items.missing_invariant: hard feasibility constraints and required execution capabilities are absent, allowing an infeasible target to win by weighted score
items.repair: filter on hard limits/capabilities before scoring feasible targets

items.implemented: detects hot links and assigns them to low-utilization links
items.core_defect: the remapper never decrements spare capacity and can map multiple overloaded links onto the same insufficient destination while reporting reroutable
items.repair: allocate only transferable excess against mutable headroom and expose residual overload/failure

items.implemented: greedy marginal failure-class coverage under a fixed case-count budget with a value tie-break
items.bounded_limit: value is only a proxy for predictive power and case costs are uniform
items.next_hardening: add explicit predictive power, case cost, and redundancy penalty before measured promotion

items.implemented: orders spans by trajectory then time and emits trajectory-local offsets
items.bounded_limit: it models the physical clustering key but not an actual ClickHouse engine/DDL benchmark
items.next_hardening: materialize the layout and compare forensic query read amplification

items.implemented: chooses the strongest verified checkpoint containing a target subgoal
items.missing_invariant: reversibility, ancestry/branch structure, and recoverable state identity are not represented
items.repair: model reversible checkpoints, parent ancestry, and state hashes

items.implemented: ranks successful-token utility against power, latency, and cost
items.missing_invariant: network, thermal, batching, and hard rack constraints described by the mechanism do not participate
items.repair: add feasibility caps plus network/thermal/batch terms before utility ranking

items.implemented: ranks architecture exposure multiplied by expected shift
items.missing_invariant: compiler compatibility, revenue exposure, and performance sensitivity are collapsed into one scalar
items.repair: model compatibility and separate revenue/performance sensitivity in adaptation priority

items.implemented: groups observations by skill and gates promotion on success across multiple robot units and sites
items.bounded_limit: skill discovery/clustering is supplied rather than learned and safety failures are not yet a hard veto
items.next_hardening: add critical-safety veto and failure-cluster diagnostics

items.implemented: requires latency improvement while keeping quality drift inside an allowed budget
items.bounded_limit: current implementation is scalar rather than workload-class specific and emits no explicit canary/rollback decision
items.next_hardening: apply per-workload budgets with explicit PROMOTE/ROLLBACK output

items.implemented: separates productive GPU minutes from provisioning/retry and other loss states
items.bounded_limit: it measures the contract but does not yet optimize the dominant loss bucket
items.next_hardening: identify and close the largest nonproductive state in a measured loop

items.implemented: checks missing nodes, authority escalation, and retry-to-non-idempotent risk
items.missing_invariant: input/output types, side effects, and failure-mode contracts named by the mechanism are not validated
items.repair: enforce type compatibility and modeled side-effect/failure semantics on edges/nodes

items.implemented: builds state and semantic-index entries with transaction/provenance metadata
items.core_defect: divergence is only set(state_ids) != set(index_ids); because both are built from the same mutations, stale content, transaction drift, and provenance drift can report clean
items.repair: compare independently derived index events against authoritative document hashes, transaction IDs, and provenance

items.implemented: computes graph reachability before/after a proposed relationship and blocks new paths into sensitive nodes
items.bounded_limit: risk is binary sensitive/not-sensitive rather than identity/resource sensitivity plus anomalous expansion scoring
items.next_hardening: add node risk and bounded path-expansion policy

items.implemented: scores retrieval configurations using downstream task success, freshness, latency, and cost
items.core_defect: the verification check accepts either cfg-a or cfg-b, so the build passes regardless of whether the optimizer chose the mathematically correct winner
items.repair: assert the exact deterministic winner and add hard outcome constraints

items.implemented: computes the nondominated capability/safety Pareto frontier
items.missing_invariant: the mechanism's automatic quarantine of capability gains with disproportionate safety regression is absent
items.repair: bind candidates to a baseline and quarantine gains exceeding a safety-regression budget

items.implemented: checks presence of simulation, software version, sensor assumptions, and degraded-mode limit
items.missing_invariant: flight evidence is not required and no evidence graph/linkage is built
items.repair: require flight evidence and emit behavior-to-evidence graph edges

items.implemented: uses measured transfer loss to choose shared-policy-plus-adapter versus embodiment-specific strategy
items.missing_invariant: no adapter is actually fitted or represented; the central embodiment mapping is assumed upstream
items.repair: fit/emit a bounded per-embodiment adapter and calculate residual transfer loss

items.implemented: filters source rows by intersection of identity roles and allowed roles
items.core_defect: policy is not propagated or revalidated through embedding, retrieval, tool, and artifact stages, which is the mechanism's defining invariant
items.repair: attach a policy envelope to every authorized datum and fail closed on policy drift at any AI stage

items.implemented: weights process/defect signatures by frequency and workload-specific impact to prioritize delivered-throughput risk
items.bounded_limit: field telemetry correlation confidence is assumed rather than measured
items.next_hardening: weight ranking by field-evidence confidence/count before promotion

items.implemented: accepts semantically equivalent outcomes using required keys, immutable fields, and numeric ranges
items.core_defect: model/tool provenance is absent, even though the mechanism explicitly requires replay provenance to distinguish acceptable nondeterminism from version drift
items.repair: record and compare model/tool provenance in the equivalence envelope

items.implemented: identifies examples where expert and base-model labels disagree
items.core_defect: disagreement mining exists, but no portable evaluator/policy layer is learned or emitted
items.repair: derive a reproducible criterion-to-expert-policy layer and use disagreement to target examples

items.implemented: canonicalizes an arbitrary config and SHA-256 fingerprints it
items.core_defect: no required passport schema is enforced; a fingerprint can be valid while weights lineage, compatibility constraints, or eval deltas are missing
items.repair: require weights lineage, quantization, sampler, kernel stack, eval deltas, and compatibility constraints before fingerprinting

items.implemented: merges time-ordered object state and rejects identity changes
items.core_defect: state is not versioned and no geometry/affordance/relationship/counterfactual graph exists, so cross-view and interaction consistency are largely untested
items.repair: compile versioned object state with invariant geometry identity, affordances, relations, viewpoints, and counterfactual records

next_gate: Repair all PARTIAL_REFERENCE and REPAIR_REQUIRED items, then require a new exact-head semantic-correctness suite covering each defining invariant before any P0 track can be labeled SEMANTICALLY_VERIFIED.
